title: Certification Package draft: outline, KSI summaries and an example Ongoing Certification Report

rows: Overview metadata: accountable official, version, last update, source
The inputs name no accountable official for the package (Q-001)
4 of the 10 policies are inputs (POL-INR, POL-CNA, POL-RPL, POL-CMT); all are drafts under the policy review
Scope: resources, flows and categories, third parties
The scope record covers all three rules but is a draft (version 0.1.0), and its exclusion conditions have no check (scope review F-001, F-004)
Supplied by a FedRAMP Recognized assessor
Not drafted in this run; the consultant asked for KSI summaries first

sheets.name: KSI summaries
rows: inr-rir-static checks that POL-INR covers the KSI, names an owner, sets a cycle of 365 days or less and that the plan has no TODO lines. inr-rir-live checks that the newest plan review is inside the cycle, was recorded by the CISO, and follows any report or review that required a plan change.
Each year, and when an after action report or a quarterly incident review finds that the plan needs to change (POL-INR INR-3).
The methods show that the owner reviewed the plan on time and after each required change. They do not show that the review judged the procedures effective (design gap).
Design status Verified: both methods were made to fail by recorded break tests (the live method on 2026-11-21). The validator build in this engagement repeated four break tests on 2026-11-22.
Latest result pass, both methods pass. History: 3 not_implemented, 2 pass.
Assessor: not supplied by the provider

rpl-rro-static checks that the RTO, RPO and review cycle are set and that POL-RPL covers the KSI. rpl-rro-live checks that the newest review of the objectives is inside the 90-day cycle and was recorded by the Platform Lead.
The methods show that objectives exist and are reviewed on time by the owner. They do not show what the review concluded or that the objectives match the restore test results (design gap).
Design status Built: the live method failed in a recorded break test; the static method's break test has not been run (assessor review F-004).
Latest result pass, both methods pass. History: 2 not_implemented, 3 pass.
Assessor: not supplied by the provider

cna-rvp-static checks that POL-CNA requires an annual review and a review after each recorded change with a deadline by change type. cna-rvp-live checks the newest protection review's age, summary, reviewer and coverage of every protection resource. cna-rvp-change checks a review follows each change in the scope change log by its deadline.
At least once a year, and after each change in the scope change log by a deadline that depends on the change type (POL-CNA CNA-7a, CNA-7b).

The methods show dated reviews by the right person, covering every protection resource and following every recorded change. They do not show that a review judged the protections effective, and changes missing from the scope change log cannot trigger a review (design gap).
Design status Built: unit tests and a manual break test of the change method on 2026-11-22.
Latest result pass, all three methods pass. History: 4 not_implemented, 1 pass.
Assessor: not supplied by the provider
